newsitem.title: USA: White House sees few cabinet announcements soon.
newsitem.headline: White House sees few cabinet announcements soon.

text.p: President Clinton is unlikely to make any cabinet nominations with the possible exception of secretary of state before his upcoming Asia trip, the White House said Tuesday.

Clinton leaves for Hawaii, Australia, the Philippines and Thailand on Friday, and White House spokesman Mike McCurry cautioned reporters against expecting any cabinet nominations "with the possible exception of secretary of state" before the president's departure.
Administration officials said former Senator George Mitchell had emerged as the clear frontrunner to succeed Secretary of State Warren Christopher, who announced his resignation last Thursday.

Defense Secretary William Perry has made it known that he also intends to resign, but has not yet formally done so. At least a half dozen cabinet posts are expected to change hands before Clinton begins his second term.
